fragments.text: Therefore we hope for Thee, O Lord our God, that we may soon behold the glory of Thy strength, that abominations may disappear from the earth and idols be entirely cut down, so that the world may be remedied through the Kingdom of the Almighty and all children of man may call upon Thy Name, and all the wicked of the earth may turn to Thee. All inhabitants of the world will perceive and know that to

Thee every knee should bow and every tongue swear. Before Thee, O Lord our God, will they kneel and fall and to the glory of Thy Name will they grant honour and they will all accept the yoke of Thy Kingdom. And Thou shalt soon reign over them for ever and ever. For Thine is the Kingdom and for all eternity shalt Thou reign in glory
